description: Use this when the user wants a direction that mixes references ("Linear's colors with Stripe's type"), or a ready-to-save brief from one site. Returns a markdown brief with exact values (role colors and site tokens, font stacks, type styles, radii, spacing, shadows, motion), caveats and source links. Deterministic: values are copied from the specs, nothing is invented. By default the 1st site gives color, the 2nd type, the 3rd layout; override with color_from/type_from/layout_from. Save the result to disk before implementing. Not for a single site's raw values (use get_design or get_design_md).

color_from.description: Site that supplies the palette (must be in `sites`).

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

layout_from.description: Site that supplies layout, shape, depth and motion (must be in `sites`).

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

product.description: What is being built, e.g. "pricing page for a dev-tools startup".

items.description: Indexed site as a slug ("linear.app"), URL ("https://linear.app/pricing") or brand name ("Linear").

type_from.description: Site that supplies typography (must be in `sites`).

name: compose_brief
title: Compose a design brief
